description: Call this when someone who lost a job asks what help, money or programs exist, for example "what benefits can I get after a layoff", "is there money to retrain" or "help to relocate for work". Verified programs that help a laid-off professional: health-coverage and cost relief while out of work, relocation money, retraining and tuition funds, tax credits, and free courses. Returns programs open to anyone in the state plus nationwide ones, each with the amount, who is eligible, status, the official page and the date it was last checked. Only programs checked against their official page are returned; programs restricted to a group or profession are left out. Filter by goal to ask for retraining or relocation funding.

goal.description: support = help while out of work, move = relocation money, retrain = tuition and training funds, tax = credits and deductions, learn = free courses. Omit for all.

limit.description: Most programs to return (1 to 25, default 10).

state.description: Two-letter U.S. state code. State programs for that state come first, then nationwide programs.
